### Summary If you run `uv audit` in [rust-lang/fls@2f683b0678541a1900e8b6fa2877c4eeff27344a](https://github.com/rust-lang/fls/tree/2f683b0678541a1900e8b6fa2877c4eeff27344a), among the advisories you will find: ```text certifi 2024.12.14 has 2 known vulnerabilities: - PYSEC-2026-4320: certifi bundles emSign root CAs with compromised intermediate CA keys Fixed in: 2026.10.18 Advisory information: https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/security/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 - PYSEC-2026-4320: certifi bundles emSign root CAs with compromised intermediate CA keys Fixed in: 2026.10.19 Advisory information: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 ``` These both refer to the same vulnerability. I've been seeing a lot of duplicates like this when using `uv audit`. You'll also notice that the second reports this as being fixed in `2026.10.19`; but this is actually fixed in `2026.10.18`, which is noted in *both* advisory information links. The full output is given below, which contains several duplicates similar to this:
